meta.description: CLI-It Hub — Agent-native stateful CLI interfaces for real software. Harness registry consumed by the `cli-it` package manager.

clis.name: demoapp
clis.description: Exemplar CLI-It harness: JSON project files, locked sessions, undo/redo, real-process export — the reference implementation of the harness pattern.

clis.name: buhocleaner
clis.description: Harness for the BuhoCleaner macOS app: read-only cleanup scans, undoable cleanup plans, live preference toggles, Sparkle update check, and GUI-driven Flash Clean via accessibility scripting (--confirm gated; every deletion is performed by BuhoCleaner itself).
clis.requires: macOS with BuhoCleaner installed (probe/plan commands work without it)

clis.name: anomalyz
clis.description: Stateful harness over the Anomalyz desktop app CLI — app/runtime status, repos, worktrees, automations, cortex memory, undoable session journal, verified exports
clis.requires: Anomalyz app built locally (node + out/cli/index.js) or `anomalyz` on PATH

clis.name: repomix
clis.description: Stateful harness over the real repomix codebase packer — reusable pack profiles, undoable profile edits, verified pack artifacts, parsed token trees and secret scans that fail loudly on upstream format drift, a JSON-sourced file inventory, and repomix's own Claude Agent Skill generator.
clis.requires: repomix on PATH (npm install -g repomix), $REPOMIX_BIN, or npx — tested against repomix 1.17.x; profile/filter/option/session commands work without it
